exam: 110年公務人員特種考試外交領事人員及外交行政人員考試、110年公務人員特種考試民航人員考試、110年公務人員特種考試原住民族考試
subject: 外交實務英文寫作(以英文命題及作答)
classes: 外交領事人員英文組二

essays.text: You are a junior official joining our government’s delegation for a meeting inBrussels held by the Steel Committee at the Organization for EconomicCooperation and Development (OECD) in April 2016, and your delegation, asan invited observer, was forced to leave the meeting on the request of theChinese communist authorities. Compose a formal letter of protest, includingthe layout of such a letter, to the OECD Steel Committee and illustrate ourgovernment’s position and arguments. The information provided in youranswer does not necessarily have to be based on facts. (30%)
Draft an official letter responding to a Taiwan-based foreign ambassador whoinquires about the contemporary South China Sea policy of our government.(30%)
Compose a brief United Nations General Assembly resolution that calls forfurther cooperation between the United Nations and the Pacific Islands Forum.(20%)

Burkina Faso decided to sever its diplomatic relations with our country in May2018. Prepare for the foreign media briefing materials that explain the contextand the position our government held. (20%)
